GHA.note: The article states no rule or authority on AI harms.
The AI tool is a customs system, which belongs to the sector study.

facts.fact: Deputy Finance Minister Thomas Ampem Nyarko said a November 2025 pilot of the Publican AI digital inspection tool flagged anomalies in 18 of 43 test transactions and recovered GHS15 million from five companies, with nationwide rollout beside ICUMS due from 1 February 2026.

GHA.note: Publican is a foreign-supplied product used in Ghana; no local AI development is stated.

facts.fact: Ghana Revenue Authority Commissioner-General Anthony Sarpong said the Integrated Customs Management System (ICUMS) has been the backbone of customs processing for over five years.
